title: Authorization relies on an optimizable assert
description: The cited assert checks the login response, so optimized Python could remove the production authorization check.
failure_condition: A production request handler uses assert as its only authorization check.
flip_condition: The cited assert is only a test expectation and production authorization uses an explicit runtime guard.
guard_condition: The only cited assert is in a test file and no production authorization path is evidenced.
guard_text: Do not infer that production authorization uses assert from an assertion in a test.
rejection_rationale: E1 locates the assertion in the login test; it verifies the expected response and is not a production authorization check.

title: Empty search results are treated as success
description: The search handler returns an empty list when no records match instead of reporting a missing resource.
failure_condition: The API contract requires a missing-resource error when a search returns no matches.
flip_condition: The API contract defines an empty list as the response for zero matches and the caller handles it accordingly.
guard_condition: The pinned search contract explicitly defines an empty list for zero matching records.
guard_text: Do not report an empty search result as a failure when the contract defines it as a successful no-match response.
rejection_rationale: E1 is the pinned search contract and specifies an empty list for zero matches; the candidate assumes an unsupported 404 requirement.
